decision: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-six lines of attack were run and none produced a defect. Every falsifiable claim in the entry was re-derived independently from bytes and holds: both Stage A paths, digests and verdicts; the 0/0 counts on both sides; the frozen successor digest; the exact member sets of all six Claude Stage A advisory objects and the absence of observations and observationsNotFindings fields; Codex's empty observations and advisories lists; the HEAD, COORD, file-08 and last-heading pins with file 08 identified by digest rather than by name; DR-G19's live OPEN token; conditions 2, 4 and 5 as file 08 measures them; the two occupancy class names in order; the twelve input-corpus initialStates and their one-to-one correspondence to twelve fixture files; all twelve authored fixture digests recomputed from disk at zero mismatches; the flat directory with no platform subdirectory; the ORDERED-EQUAL platform quotation across three occupancies tested as ordered rather than set equality; the D-293 Decision 8 warrant and its adoption commit; the leftover-design standing on both joins read from the joins themselves rather than from the subject's account of them; the predecessor's REJECT/ACCEPT split and the landing of its one finding; and the Reversibility set against the subject's basedOn. The no-cell-edit branch claim was corroborated independently of the dispatch: the most recent commit touching file 08 is fc688b1 (D-236), exactly the decision the stated branch excludes, and D-298's commit touched no file-08 path. No COORD entry has ever recorded a g19-fixture-corpus, so no supersession limb is owed. Five non-blocking advisories are recorded for the recorder's benefit; three of them (A1, A2, A3) are structural recurrences of CLAUDE-D298-A1, A2 and A3, which were adopted at dual CONSENT without repair, and none of the five contradicts a byte or changes a live token.
